Watch for May 9 forecast updates and early May 10 observations from official stations.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects BMKG's latest forecast for May 10 in DKI Jakarta, projecting highs of 25–31°C amid widespread berawan (cloudy skies) and light rain in southern and eastern districts, capping solar insolation and favoring sub-30°C outcomes. With outcomes tightly clustered, uncertainty stems from short-range forecast variability—possible clearing could push peaks toward 30°C, while intensified showers favor 28°C or below. Watch BMKG's daily updates tomorrow for refined guidance ahead of resolution via official station measurements.
